bundle.shortDescription: Tiny PDF and PNG viewer with one-second live reload
bundle.longDescription: pdf-next opens PDFs and images, follows your system dark mode, searches text, and reloads within a second of the file changing on disk — built for the LaTeX and Typst compile loop.
